name: bklit-ui
title: Bklit UI
responsibility: Design-engineered chart components — polished, animated data visualization without building chart UI from scratch.
upstreamNotice: Full snapshot: registry.json (56 items) + r/<item>.json with complete file contents. Refresh: curl -sL https://ui.bklit.com/r/<name>.json -o r/<name>.json
itemShape: shadcn registry-item: { name, type, title, description, dependencies[], registryDependencies[], files[{ path, target, content }] }. files[].content is raw TSX; targets land under src/.

resolution.@bklit/*: local snapshot: bklit/r/<name>.json (vendored recursively by create-preset.py --bk)
resolution.plain names (card, badge, …): shadcn base kit — resolve from watermelon/r/<name>.json

reachFor: Landing-page-grade charts where visual polish matters (area, line, bar, radial, funnel, heatmap)
Stat cards and insight blocks that embed live charts
Animated, token-styled visualization that matches the shadcn design language
avoid: Plain utility charting with zero design needs — Recharts is lighter
Pretending it is a dependency: it is source you vendor and own (shadcn model)
inRepo: new snapshot 2026-09-01; first consumers expected under insight/ and app/ (see kpi-tile-live for the Recharts alternative)
